findings.sentence: Nestled in Warner Robins, Georgia, the Museum of Aviation stands as a testament to the rich heritage of the United States Air Force and the marvels of aviation.
findings.why: Generic significance does not explain the effect on the reader.
findings.fix: Use a supplied consequence, or cut the unsupported praise.
findings.keep_when: Keep significance supported by specific evidence in context.

findings.matched_text: As the second-largest museum in the Air Force's network, this sprawling facility offers visitors an immersive experience that combines history, education, and inspiration.
findings.sentence: As the second-largest museum in the Air Force's network, this sprawling facility offers visitors an immersive experience that combines history, education, and inspiration.
findings.suggestion: Consider naming the concrete properties rather than a string of general qualities.
findings.why: General qualities can leave the reader without a concrete property.
findings.fix: Use actual supported properties, or keep a parallel list if it communicates them.
findings.keep_when: Keep factual triples, intentional rhetoric and technical categories.

findings.suggestion: 8 short units; distinguish complete sentences, dialogue and deliberate emphasis before editing.
findings.why: Several very short units may interrupt the argument.
findings.fix: Check which units are complete sentences and which fragments need connection.
findings.keep_when: Keep dialogue, slogans, instructions and deliberate emphasis.

findings.matched_text: not just a place to admire aircraft; it's
findings.sentence: The museum is not just a place to admire aircraft; it's a hub for learning and innovation.
findings.suggestion: Check whether this pattern makes the point harder to follow; retain justified wording.
findings.why: A repeated contrast can obscure what changed.
findings.fix: State the relationship directly while retaining the original distinction.
findings.keep_when: Keep a contrast that corrects a likely misunderstanding.

findings.suggestion: Short-unit annotation; a complete short sentence or a deliberate fragment can be appropriate.

findings.fix: Treat this as an annotation. Read surrounding units before changing it.
findings.keep_when: Keep complete short sentences, dialogue and a single punchy fragment.

findings.suggestion: Check heading case against the venue's style; title case may be required.
findings.why: Heading capitalization may distract if it conflicts with the venue style.
findings.fix: Use the required or established heading style consistently.
findings.keep_when: Keep title case when the publication or naming convention requires it.

findings.sentence: From the sleek SR-71 Blackbird to the formidable B-29 Superfortress, the collection showcases the evolution of aviation technology and its pivotal role in shaping history.
findings.why: A familiar general word may hide the action or property intended.
findings.fix: Use the precise term or an ordinary verb if it preserves meaning.
findings.keep_when: Keep technical terms such as robust statistics, quoted language and the author’s intentional voice.
